title: Run Brownian dynamics simulation
action: Implement the two-subsystem Brownian dynamics model (Eqs. 10-11) with parameters N1=N2 up to 1e3, periodic boundaries, temperature T=1, damping η=1, potential V(|R|)=V_jj' exp(-R^2/a_jj'), with V11=V12, V22=3V12, a11=a22=0.875, a12=0.5. Run simulations for a range of V22 values from 0 to V22_max=50 in steps, recording the steady-state particle trajectories for the substrate subsystem after equilibration.
description: Heavy simulation step that generates the raw particle configurations needed for order parameter extraction. Its execution is forced by downstream load-bearing step.

title: Compute order parameter and compile results table
action: From the simulated substrate trajectories, compute the two-body correlation function G11(q) via Fourier transform, locate the diffraction peak corresponding to the substrate-induced structure (the b-peak from the V22=0 reference). For each V22 value, calculate the order parameter as 1 - G11(q_b; V22)/G11(q_b; V22=0). Also solve the mean-field self-consistent relation (Eq. 8) numerically using the same parameters to obtain the theoretical order parameter. Write a CSV file containing columns: V22_relative_strength, order_parameter_sim, order_parameter_theory.
description: Main scored artifact: order parameter values as a function of relative adsorbate-adsorbate interaction strength, from simulation and theory. The checker will recompute the inflection point of the simulated curve and compare to a hidden gold threshold.
output_schema: Columns: V22_relative_strength (float, unitless ratio V22 / V22_max), order_parameter_sim (float, unitless normalized height difference), order_parameter_theory (float, optional, unitless theory prediction).
